request.description: Train the current baseline PPO policy with the existing 14-20 cm training-radius exposure, 64x64 tanh policy, and configured runtime parameters to establish the first candidate and learning trajectory.
request.rationale: The initial mechanistic distinction is exposure-limited generalization to the official 6-20 cm distribution versus a shared reach-and-hold stabilization limitation. With no learned artifact yet, a baseline training run is the necessary first action: it creates comparable checkpoints and runtime state whose official-distribution diagnostics can separate inner-band/branch failures from acquisition and uninterrupted-hold failures. This does not treat training proxies as performance evidence; it establishes the candidate needed for the next measurement.
